$Comment: Orrin's weekly: a long week at the table, counted three ways.
Repeat.Reset with Period Weekly is a CALENDAR weekly: the allowance refreshes at the week
boundary on server time. Author Weekday on the Reset block to move the boundary, or replace
Period with an Every block to set any other length.
It opens once The Essence Draw is claimed, so every player who takes it has drawn essence in
numbers before. All three steps sit on Order 1, so they run together through the week:
week_rites counts pieces the tables took apart (STATION_INPUT, blank Target so any piece
counts, qualified to 'Disenchanting_Table' on PREFIX so both tiers count and the Sawmill does
not, with the shared unmake_gear TextKey); week_essence counts Life essence the tables handed
over (STATION_OUTPUT, exact id, the same qualifier); week_void hands Void essence in to Orrin
only (TurnInNpcId 'giver'), which the tables find in good gear. Raise or lower any of the
three Amounts to change how long a week's unmaking takes.
Rewards sit in Claim: Enchanting XP, a long personal Enchanting boost token (the Mmo_Boost_Token
kind: Skill, Multiplier, DurationMinutes) and two Disenchanter's Draughts, the jar's potion
that hurries the ritual along. Listing puts it in the misc category on the same shelf as the
daily and the short order, one place after them.
Name: A_Weeks_Unmaking
